eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Coconino, AZ; at 11:30 AM on AUG 21, 2025 Effective until 3:30 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Coconino County Sheriffs Office is pleased to announce we are changing the status from SET to READY for the Forest Lakes area.  This encompasses the north and south residences of highway 260 between mile post 286 and mile post 291. Canyon Point Campground is also included in this status update.  This decision was made in conjunction with the United States Forest Service.
